label: Systemic atopy and upper-airway disease define susceptibility to incident asthma after COVID-19 in Korea.
summary: Incident asthma is an important respiratory sequela after COVID-19, but it is unclear which allergic phenotypes amplify risk. Using a linked nationwide Korean database of 3,987,182 individuals with confirmed severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 infection, we compare claims-based incident asthma in those with pre-existing systemic atopy and/or upper-airway disease (allergic rhinitis, chronic rhinosinusitis, atopic dermatitis or food allergy) versus those without after 1:1 propensity s…
